_comment: Copy to config.json, or set ARTEX_CONFIG to another path. This file configures only database and skill_dir; configure the LLM and other settings through environment variables or the application.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: ARTEX_PG_DSN environment variable, then this database configuration. Use either the individual fields below or one complete database.dsn connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Alternative: replace the database section above with a complete DSN. A nonempty dsn takes priority over the individual fields.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory; each subdirectory contains a SKILL.md. Priority: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR environment variable, then this field, then skills/ beside the executable. Leave empty to use the default. Relative paths resolve from the current working directory.
